# Charisma: Rally
Charisma increases the loadout points available during character creation.
At [bold]10 effective Charisma[/bold], you gain [bold]Rally[/bold]. Activate it to encourage every living player within [bold]six tiles[/bold], regardless of faction. It does not affect the person using it or NPCs.
For [bold]20 seconds[/bold], affected players gain [bold]20% faster walking and sprinting[/bold], take [bold]25% less stamina damage[/bold], and ignore movement slowdown caused by damage. Other restrictions, such as heavy equipment or disabled limbs, still apply. Rally does not heal injuries or revive anyone.
When activated, you call out one of four encouraging phrases. The softly shaded light-blue circle shows the activation range. Only players inside it when you activate Rally receive the buff. They keep it if they leave; entering the circle later gives no benefit.
Rally has a [bold]three-minute cooldown from activation[/bold]. Multiple Rallies refresh the duration without stacking their bonuses. Temporarily lowering Charisma does not reset the cooldown.
